newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO says too early for 1997 forecast.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO says too early for 1997 forecast.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Thursday it was too early to make a profit forecast for 1997 because of uncertainties surrounding financial markets.

"The managing board looks forward to the future development of the bank with confidence. In the light of the uncertainties surrounding the financial markets, the board finds it too early to make a profit forecast for 1997," the bank said in a statement with 1996 results.
The bank earlier reported a net profit of 3.30 billion guilders for calendar 1996, up 26.3 percent on 1995.
